clue.text: False religion upsets purists, I note

definitions.note: a groundless belief in omens and magic, treated as a false faith

indicators.note: upsets tells us the letters of the following words are knocked over and rearranged

explanation.surface: A heretical faith that annoys the purists, I would point out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upsets' rearranges the twelve letters of PURISTS, I and NOTE together.
explanation.definitionFit: Belief in luck, omens and charms is irrational faith, so it can be called a false religion.

clue.text: Make dotty drawing of Sligo's original jigger

parts.note: a jigger is a measure of spirits, so a drink or tipple

explanation.surface: An Irish town's first jig dancer, oddly linked to a dotty sketch.
explanation.walkthrough: Sligo is a town in Ireland; a jigger here is a small measure of spirits, not a dancer.
explanation.definitionFit: To stipple is to draw or paint using many small dots rather than lines.

explanation.definitionFit: The primula is a genus of garden plant that includes the primrose and cowslip.

clue.text: Descriptive of all those stalls in Covent Garden

definitions.text: Descriptive of all those stalls in Covent Garden

parts.words: Descriptive of all those stalls in Covent Garden
parts.note: Covent Garden was a London market full of stalls, but it is also home to the Royal Opera House, whose stalls seats lie nearest the stage, the theatre's public side

explanation.surface: A description of all the market stalls in London's Covent Garden.
explanation.walkthrough: Covent Garden in London was famous for its market stalls; the Royal Opera House stands there, and theatre stalls are seats.
explanation.definitionFit: Theatre staff and areas dealing with the audience, like the seating, are the public-facing side of the venue.

clue.text: Fruit gardener's first gathering

clue.text: Those competing for records

clue.text: One claret affected bearing

clue.text: Curious lad upset without a comic

clue.text: Hair taken up, to us, evinces charm

clue.text: It's thought to be a help in soap production
